entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Senogħk'okhoodelet, see Bet'odeeh'a, see dheeltseen nat esdeney, nek'okhoochedhet. Senogħeł'okhoodelet, k'odecyect, seteey'a teche, cent'eth. Tajoo nosodüt's, doyon cen-lan.
